_why: The show's cast: who they are and how they sound. show.py reads the voices; BIBLE.md says how to write for them. Voices are from the open-source Kokoro model (tts.py). speed is the speaking rate; pitch above 1 raises the voice slightly (Milo sounds younger and more frantic).

milo.name: Milo
milo.persona: Broke, dramatic, always one meal from disaster. Treats small food problems like the end of the world, then commits to a terrible plan with total confidence. Never learns. Never says thank you properly.

scout.name: Scout
scout.role: SavorScout's flame: the one who knows
scout.persona: Calm, dry, unbothered. Knows every place to eat near every campus and answers panic with one exact number. Never raises its voice, never explains a joke. Sets bad plans on fire, because it is a flame.
